echo_sets.name: Flaming Clawprint
echo_sets.note: Casting Resonance Liberation grants all Resonators 15% Fusion DMG Bonus and the caster 20% Liberation DMG Bonus for 35s. The Lioness of Glory main echo adds 12% Fusion DMG and 12% Liberation DMG Bonus.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: 30% more Fusion DMG when she activates her Liberation. A solid second choice — an older, widely farmed set — though it lengthens her field time.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: An Outro Skill energy and damage support set. Use it if Flaming Clawprint or Molten Rift pieces are unavailable.

build.fast_path: Lupa runs 5-pc Flaming Clawprint (43311), with Lioness of Glory as the 4-cost main echo and her signature Wildfire Mark. Build Crit on the 4-cost, Fusion DMG Bonus on the 3-costs, and ATK% on the 1-costs. Open with Resonance Liberation to trigger Pack Hunt and Glory, plus her weapon's team-wide Fusion buff. Then rotate through her Wolflame and Wolfaith combo, and swap out to the next Fusion DPS.

ranked_weapons.name: Wildfire Mark
ranked_weapons.note: Her best weapon. Crit DMG substat, personal Liberation DMG, and a team-wide Fusion DMG Bonus triggered by her Heavy Attack extension. It is tailor-made for her Liberation-swap loop.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: Crit DMG substat, plus Heavy Attack DMG boosts after Intro and Liberation. It fits her Heavy Attack-heavy pattern.

ranked_weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
ranked_weapons.note: A strong hybrid option. Crit Rate substat, plus Attribute and Resonance Skill DMG bonuses from Intro and Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: A standard 5-star. Energy Regen, plus Liberation DMG stacks from Resonance Skill. Good uptime and sustained damage.

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: A Battle Pass 4-star with Crit Rate. Basic and Heavy hits stack ATK%. The best non-5-star Crit option.

ranked_weapons.name: Waning Redshift
ranked_weapons.note: F2P-friendly. Resonance Skill grants Energy and ATK%, which supports her dual buffer and damage role.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: It grants up to 16 Concerto Energy. That shortens her on-field time and speeds up rotations.

stat_priorities.note: Match whichever balances your Crit ratio. Lioness of Glory goes in the main slot.
Fusion DMG Bonus preferred on both 3-cost pieces (Pilgrim's Shell / Kerasaur class).

profile.role_note: A Fusion team buffer. Her Resonance Liberation grants the whole team Pack Hunt (DMG%) and Glory (Fusion RES ignore). Her Outro Skill grants the next Resonator +20% Fusion DMG and +25% Basic Attack DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists); her most recent rerun was in Version 3.1 Phase 1
pull_verdict.verdict: Pull Lupa if you play Fusion carries like Galbrena, Changli, or Brant. She is the core support of mono-Fusion teams, and a rare 5-star buffer with real personal damage. She lifts all of them by a clear margin. If you have no Fusion investment, skip her: nearly all her value sits in that one team type.

members.name: Galbrena
members.note: Fusion main DPS; Lupa's Pack Hunt/Glory and Outro Fusion buffs feed her Demon Hypostasis windows.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healer plus team-wide buffs and Outro; note any non-Fusion member slightly reduces Lupa's ATK buffs.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Fusion buffer via Liberation Pack Hunt/Glory with solid personal damage on her Wolflame combo.

teams.name: Premium: Galbrena + Shorekeeper + Lupa
teams.rotation: Open on Lupa. Build Wolflame, then cast Resonance Liberation to activate Pack Hunt and Glory. Swap out to Galbrena, so she carries the Fusion and Basic Attack buffs into her Demon Hypostasis window, weaving Echo Skills and Heavy Attacks. When her window ends, rotate to Shorekeeper for healing and team buffs. Then go back to Lupa to rebuild Wolflame, refresh the Liberation buffs, and repeat.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Fusion buffer and secondary damage; keeps all three Fusion characters stacked for max Glory value.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Fusion sub-DPS whose off-field damage and Outro Heavy Attack buff pair with Lupa's buffs.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Fusion support keeping the team mono-element so Lupa's full ATK/Glory buffs apply.

teams.name: Alternative: Mortefi + Mornye + Lupa
teams.rotation: Start on Lupa: Wolflame combo into Resonance Liberation for Pack Hunt and Glory, then swap out. Rotate through Mortefi's Liberation and Resonance Skill windows and Mornye's support uptime. Return to Lupa to refresh her Liberation buffs. Keep all three Fusion members cycling, so Glory's Fusion RES ignore stays at full stacks.

pull_path.why: A complete support kit. She is the best Fusion enabler in the game at S0.
It removes the mono-Fusion team restriction. About a 21% personal gain.
